about: The ratchet over the Admin Garden scoreboard: the name of every item that is open under each count, one to a line, in order. An open item that is not named here fails server/gardenScoreboard.test.ts. A name may always leave. `npx tsx scripts/garden-scoreboard.ts --ratchet` drops the names that are no longer open and never adds one. A name added by hand is something that arrived without a home, and the reviewer of that line let it through.
